content.text:
A mule (donkey sire x horse mare), a real hybrid animal. Horse-sized body with deep chest, long back, long neck and horse proportions, with the donkey's long ears, short thick head, short upright mane, thin legs, small hooves and tufted tail; plain coat with no stripes or spots. Head fully visible and uncluttered, with clear, discernible eyes. Bilaterally symmetrical, recognizable limbs, visible sense organs. One creature, full body, side three-quarter view, plain light background, natural history illustration.
Aspect ratio: 1:1.

summary.text:
**Drafting natural history illustration**
I'm planning a vintage natural history illustration of a single mule, side three-quarter full body on a plain light background, with horse-sized proportions and donkey traits like long ears, short thick head, and tufted tail, emphasizing clear eyes and bilateral symmetry.
**Composing natural history illustration**
I'm preparing a detailed watercolor/engraving of a mule in side three-quarter view with plain light background, showing long donkey ears, short thick head, upright mane, tufted tail, thin legs, and small hooves.
**Refining horse proportions**
I'm preparing another generation with deeper chest and larger horse-like proportions, adjusting the build to look less donkey-like while keeping the natural history style.
